rule: Every slot must reference a plugins.json entry with test=verified. Never pick highest-star pending.

keyword_sources.gsc: Agent transcript GSC snapshot for sc-domain:dshbase.com (28d ending ~2026-08-16): top queries included dsh-better-sidebar, dsh-genui, dsh-web-ui, dsh-at-file, dsh vision toolkit, dsh-find-plugin, dsh-openpencil, github dsh; top pages /install/, /plugins/DSH-better-sidebar/, /zh/blog/dsh-model-setup/, /plugins/directory/ (high impressions, low CTR).
keyword_sources.ga4: No live GA4 export used this session.
keyword_sources.transcripts: Claude memory keyword-root-methodology.md + dshbase-site.md seed phrases: DeepSeek Harness, DSH plugins, verified plugin packs, scene packs, vs Claude Code.
keyword_sources.method: Combine GSC query phrases as anchor text with persona intent (developer/artist/accountant/student/teacher/writer/researcher).

packs.desc_en: A verified DeepSeek Harness plugin pack for developers: token usage, Claude Code-style TUI, LSP actions, Git graph, better sidebar, and @file mentions — every slot install-tested on dshbase.
packs.desc_zh: 面向程序员的 DeepSeek Harness 已验证插件包：Token 用量、类 Claude Code 的 TUI、LSP 动作、Git 图、更好侧边栏与 @file 提及——每个槽位都在 dshbase 实测通过。
packs.audience_en: Best for engineers who want a coding agent workbench without guessing which DSH plugins actually install.
packs.audience_zh: 适合想搭编程 Agent 工作台、又不想猜哪些 DSH 插件真能装上的工程师。

packs.title_zh: 艺术家 / 创意视觉包
packs.desc_en: Give text-only DeepSeek Harness models eyes and a design surface: vision bridge, vision toolkit, OpenPencil design preview, and GenUI interactive charts — verified-only scene pack.
packs.desc_zh: 给纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 模型加「眼睛」和设计画布：视觉桥、vision toolkit、OpenPencil 预览与 GenUI 交互图表——仅含已验证插件的场景包。
packs.audience_en: Designers, illustrators, and builders who paste screenshots, iterate UI, or need OCR and layout feedback inside DSH.
packs.audience_zh: 需要在 DSH 里贴图、改 UI、做 OCR 或版式反馈的设计师、插画师与创作者。

packs.desc_en: Office docs, Excel chat, finance workflows, and AnyDoc conversion for accountants running DeepSeek Harness — spreadsheet and PDF slots verified on dshbase.
packs.desc_zh: 面向会计与财务运营的 DeepSeek Harness 场景包：办公文档、Excel 对话、财务流程与 AnyDoc 转换——表格与 PDF 相关槽位均已验证。
packs.audience_en: Bookkeepers, finance ops, and ops teams who work in xlsx/PDF and want an agent that can read and edit those files.
packs.audience_zh: 天天跟 xlsx/PDF 打交道、希望 Agent 能读写这些文件的会计、财务与运营同学。

packs.desc_en: Local-first explanations, mind maps from courseware, DeepTutor learning threads, bookmarks, and durable memory — a verified DSH plugin pack for students.
packs.desc_zh: 本地优先讲解、课件转脑图、DeepTutor 学习线程、书签与长期记忆——面向学生的 DeepSeek Harness 已验证插件包。
packs.audience_en: Students who need study notes, spaced explanations, and saved answers without installing random high-star plugins.
packs.audience_zh: 需要笔记、讲解与收藏答案，又不想乱装高 Star 未测插件的学生。

packs.desc_en: Classrooms and Socratic teaching with OpenMAIC, courseware mind maps, GenUI quizzes/charts, and DeepTutor bridges — verified DeepSeek Harness plugins for educators.
packs.desc_zh: OpenMAIC 课堂与苏格拉底式教学、课件脑图、GenUI 测验/图表、DeepTutor 桥接——面向老师的已验证 DeepSeek Harness 插件包。
packs.audience_en: Teachers and tutors building lesson flows, slides, and interactive checks inside DSH.
packs.audience_zh: 要在 DSH 里做备课、课件与互动测验的老师与辅导者。

packs.desc_en: Long-form writing engine, academic writing guard, Markdown preview, and better streaming Markdown for writers using DeepSeek Harness — verified slots only.
packs.desc_zh: 长文写作引擎、学术写作卫士、Markdown 预览与更好的流式 Markdown——面向写作者的 DeepSeek Harness 已验证场景包。
packs.audience_en: Novelists, essayists, and technical writers who need structure, hygiene checks, and readable drafts in DSH.
packs.audience_zh: 需要结构、写作卫生检查与可读草稿的小说、论文与技术写作者。

packs.desc_en: arXiv/OpenAlex scholar search, local Zotero cite, web search, and clean URL reading — a verified DeepSeek Harness pack for researchers.
packs.desc_zh: arXiv/OpenAlex 学术检索、本地 Zotero 引用、网页搜索与干净 URL 阅读——面向研究者的已验证 DeepSeek Harness 场景包。
packs.audience_en: Grad students and analysts who chase papers, citations, and source pages from inside the agent.
packs.audience_zh: 要在 Agent 里追论文、引用与原始网页的研究生与分析师。

packs.desc_en: Paste images, run OCR, and route vision tools when your DeepSeek model is text-only — dsh vision toolkit and friends, all L3/L4 verified.
packs.desc_zh: 模型是纯文本时也能贴图、OCR、路由视觉工具——含 dsh vision toolkit 等，全部 L3/L4 已验证。
packs.audience_en: Anyone hitting “model can’t see images” who needs a verified vision bridge pack.
packs.audience_zh: 遇到「模型看不见图」、需要已验证视觉桥场景包的用户。

packs.desc_en: Cross-session memory plugins that passed our install tests — evolve, Mnemon, and core memory for DeepSeek Harness agents.
packs.desc_zh: 跨会话记忆插件——记忆进化、Mnemon 与核心记忆，仅收录通过安装实测的条目。
packs.audience_en: Users who want agents that remember projects across days, not just one chat.
packs.audience_zh: 希望 Agent 跨天记住项目上下文、而不只记得单次对话的用户。

packs.desc_en: Reach Feishu, WeChat, Telegram, and DingTalk from DeepSeek Harness — verified IM integration plugins only.
packs.desc_zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到飞书、微信、Telegram、钉钉——只收已验证的 IM 接入插件。
packs.audience_en: Teams that live in chat apps and want the agent where work already happens.
packs.audience_zh: 日常在聊天软件里协作、希望 Agent 就在工作入口的团队。

packs.desc_en: Local security audits and scan packs we actually ran — pair with the dshbase audit methodology page.
packs.desc_zh: 本地安全审计与扫描包——我们真跑过；可配合 dshbase 审计方法页一起看。
packs.audience_en: Operators reviewing plugin risk before widening permissions.
packs.audience_zh: 在放宽权限前想先过一遍插件风险的运维与安全同学。

packs.desc_en: dsh better sidebar, in-agent catalog discovery, and a featured TUI — the UI plugins people search for, verified on dshbase.
packs.desc_zh: dsh better sidebar、站内目录发现与精选 TUI——别人常搜的 UI 插件，已在 dshbase 验证。
packs.audience_en: Users hunting for a better sidebar, dsh-web-ui style panels, or in-DSH plugin finders.
packs.audience_zh: 在找更好侧边栏、类 dsh-web-ui 面板，或站内插件发现能力的用户。
